GameplayEvent Rules4 sections
Event Gameplay

◆During the event, Transcenders can spend 1 Crow's Ticket to draw a random reward, including the limited-time costumes. Check the reward detail through "Details."

Crow's Ticket

◆During the event, Transcenders can obtain Crow's Tickets through daily tasks and limited bundles.

Story

◆There is a chance to obtain Story Fragment during the draw. After collecting enough fragments, you can watch the Story.

Crow's Treasure

◆After collecting all the Story Fragments, there is a chance to obtain Crow's Pearl in Crow's Theatre. Collect enough Crow's Pearl to redeem rewards in Crow's Treasure.
